Frasers Hospitality is a 10-time recipient of the Best Serviced Residence Operator at the TTG Travel Awards, one of the most highly sought-after accolades within the travel industry in Asia Pacific, determined by the votes of seasoned travel agents and holds the spotlight on the trust that both travellers and industry experts place in Frasers Hospitality. We have also been recognised as the ultimate hallmark of quality at the ‘Travel Oscars’, organised by the World Travel Awards - the largest and most prestigious awards in the global travel and tourism industry. As a result, we have been named the World’s Leading Serviced Apartment Brand in numerous countries. In China we are lauded as the Annual Excellent Luxury Serviced Apartment Operator in China at the China Starlight Hotel Awards. We have also earned accolades from respected travel media for both innovation and exemplary service. Underlying our achievements is our attention to detail in every single aspect of hospitality whether at corporate or property level. Be it branding, marketing, construction, interior design, residence management or investment, we set the standards in excellence. All of which culminate in our efforts to put the guest experience above all else - ensuring that we are always a step ahead to anticipate and cater to their ever-evolving needs.
